title: OmniProject canonical field
description: One work-item field in the canonical vocabulary. The fields are authored as a single JSON array (assets/fields.json), validated element-by-element against this schema and embedded by gen-fields.

core.description: Always present on any issue-tracking backend (never gated off).

required.description: Must be provided when creating the owning entity.

references.description: For type: reference — the entity key this field points at (e.g. programme).

entity.description: The canonical entity (table) this field belongs to. Defaults to 'issue' when omitted. Drives which table a field becomes a column on in the superset-native self-host DB schema generator.

options.description: For type: enum — the allowed values (a canonical, id-safe allow-list; lower_snake_case). Threaded to the live superset and the sidecar enumeration, so a UI element bound to the field inherits this choice set as a validation floor (deriveValidationRule → checkFieldValue). A deployment may extend/override it via the field overlay. Only meaningful on an enum field.

maxLength.description: Max character length for string/text/reference fields — the value-bound a linked UI element inherits (absent ⇒ the type's default ceiling).

precision.description: Decimal places for number/currency/percent fields (display + rounding hint).

pattern.description: A regular-expression the value must match (e.g. a postcode/email/reference shape). ReDoS-guarded before use (isSafePattern) wherever it is enforced.
